description: A diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that preserves the DiagnosisProbe(view, device) interface while supporting changes to the trained recommendation model. run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns metrics and metric_definitions grounded in available data.
motivation: Keep model diagnosis compatible across architecture changes and ensure that improvement decisions use observable evidence and the shared validation objective.
implementation_notes: Retain all four datasets and their routing. Diagnose the actual view.model through architecture-appropriate implementations of item_emb, log2feats and predict_score. Training batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Use only public interaction histories, titles, descriptions and timestamps; treat unavailable review content, ratings, item attributes and simulator traits as unobserved. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for 20 real training users, five per category. Select models by macro-average validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator, without accessing hidden test data. If inference changes, update the predictor writer to load the trained architecture.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device):
        store view and device

    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve view.model.training
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        with gradients disabled:
            inspect batches using architecture-compatible scoring
            compute supported diagnostics from observed data
            generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations
                for five real training users per category
        restore previous model mode
        return metrics, metric_definitions

Use independently evaluated macro validation HR@10 for model selection.

originality.positive: Specifies a consistent diagnostic contract across evolving model architectures.
originality.negative: Describes integration requirements rather than a new recommendation algorithm or diagnostic estimator.

future_potential.positive: Can support comparable, evidence-based diagnosis as architectures and training objectives evolve.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on defining useful probes and demonstrating that diagnostic findings improve validation performance.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interface and batch structure are explicit.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture adaptation, full-catalog scoring and handling unavailable observations require care.
